capability: Recover a governing mechanism from a queryable experimental system within a fixed experiment budget.

workdir.description: Caller-selected directory for the workspace: environment.json, models/, observations, ledger and final_result.json.

environment.description: The autoscilab-env/1 spec (references/environment-spec.md) as an object, or a path to an environment.json file. It defines inputs, observables, budget, oracle command and target output format.

confidence_threshold.description: Bootstrap confidence threshold tau for switching from disambiguate to refine mode; default 0.9.

caller_tag.description: Log-only opaque caller identifier echoed in the response.

status.description: Outcome of the closed-loop discovery run.

queries_used.description: Total oracle queries or manual measurements consumed.

final_mechanism.description: The recovered mechanism, written in the environment's target.output_format.

result_path.description: Path to <workdir>/final_result.json, which also holds the winning model's source, fitted parameters and the protocol audit.

errors.description: Blocking problems on error, or what is missing on needs_input.

rules: An environment that fails validate-env returns needs_input with the validation errors and writes nothing.
An environment without oracle.command and no way to obtain manual measurements returns needs_input before any workspace is created.
completed means final_result.json exists with audit.passed true; queries_used never exceeds budget.
queries_used, budget, final_mechanism and result_path are present when status is completed; final_mechanism and result_path are omitted on needs_input and error.
The system under study is accessed only through the environment spec and oracle responses; its implementation, task metadata and ground truth are never read.
caller_tag is log-only and never affects experiment selection or mechanism arbitration.

changes.note: Initial contract for closed-loop active scientific mechanism discovery.

Request takes an autoscilab-env/1 environment instead of inline parameters and representation-specific fields; hypotheses are agent-written model modules; final_mechanism follows the environment's target.output_format.
